cleaning_operations.rationale: Exact matching order-line records artificially duplicate transactions and distort true product demand.
Uniform datetime formatting enables chronological sorting, expanding-window validation, and daily aggregation.
Aligns primary transaction identifier with enterprise relational schema standards.

cleaning_operations.operation: Derive UnitPrice and DiscountRate from Gross Sales and Quantity
cleaning_operations.method: UnitPrice = (Sales + Discount) / Quantity; DiscountRate = Discount / (Sales + Discount)
cleaning_operations.rationale: Discount is dollar concession; back-calculating Gross Sales recovers exact positive catalog UnitPrice and fractional DiscountRate.

cleaning_operations.operation: Filter non-positive quantities and non-positive sales
cleaning_operations.rationale: Forward sales demand must be strictly positive; non-positive entries reflect cancellations or corrupted records.

cleaning_operations.operation: Normalize categorical text casing and strip whitespace
cleaning_operations.rationale: Inconsistent casing fragments SKU sales across duplicate product name variants.

cleaning_operations.operation: Perform IQR outlier detection across financial metrics
cleaning_operations.rationale: Large commercial wholesale orders represent authentic high-demand spikes; auditing flags them for tree models without discarding legitimate sales.

cleaning_operations.operation: Purge post-transaction accounting leakage (COS, GP) and administrative attributes
cleaning_operations.rationale: COS and GP are computed post-sale (Sales = COS + GP); keeping them causes 100% target leakage. Admin fields contain non-generalizable noise.
